description: This file defines an abstract class for managing Definition caches within the HTMLPurifier library, including common methods for cache management and a factory pattern.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache
classes.description: Abstract class providing common methods and a factory pattern for cache managers handling HTML definitions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a specific definition type.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a unique cache key based on configuration version, batch serial, and revision.

methods.name: isOld
methods.description: Checks if a cache key is outdated based on the current configuration.

methods.name: checkDefType
methods.description: Verifies if a definition object matches the cache's type.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Abstract method to add a definition object to the cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Abstract method to unconditionally save a definition object to the cache.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Abstract method to replace an existing cache entry.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a definition object from the cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a cache entry.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Abstract method to clear all cache entries.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Abstract method to remove expired cache entries.
